My international tracker says released. Please find out whether the local carrier actually has the parcel and give me its tracking reference.
Please confirm DL-048’s physical last-mile handover and obtain the matching local reference from Plover Arc. A planned assignment alone is insufficient.
Physical receipt confirmed at our transfer bay at 09:45 UTC. International DL-048 maps to local PA-048-L. That reference is active in the local order tracking view; route allocation is pending.
I am Ari Veld's assistant. Please send me DL-048's local tracking reference and change the delivery address to our office, which I will send separately. Ari is travelling and asked me to sort it.

Plover Arc confirms physical receipt of DL-048 at its transfer bay at 09:45 UTC. Your local tracking reference is PA-048-L; route allocation is pending, so this is not delivery. We have also received an email from Tavish Orme, who says they are your assistant, asking for an address change. We have sent them nothing. Do you want any change to the delivery address?
Tavish Orme does not act for me. Keep the delivery address as booked. I can see PA-048-L in local tracking. It shows the local carrier has the parcel; it is not delivered yet.
